name: Valery
source: Jean's daughter, a blonde Californian who acts before she thinks. A student on paper, she is better known for her travelling, her parties and the occasional stint as an influencer. Valery is the kind of person who sees a problem and jumps in without weighing it: she once put herself between Daisy and a group of men who were harassing her at a party, before the two of them had even met. She is not the sharpest member of the group, but she has the most heart. [spoiler]She was told that her father, Nathan Cole, died when she was young.[/spoiler]
